methodology:
SD Guthrie (rebranded from Sime Darby Plantation in May 2024) is the world's largest pure-play palm oil planter by area: ~600K hectares across 4 country/region clusters.

4-row breakdown:
- Peninsular Malaysia (432K acres / ~175K ha): premium plantation + integrated downstream
- Sabah (247K acres / ~100K ha): mature plantation cluster
- Indonesia (494K acres / ~200K ha): Sumatra + Kalimantan diversified
- PNG + Solomon Islands (198K acres / ~80K ha): inherited from NBPOL/RAMU acquisition; lower per-acre due to remoteness + concession-stage area

Per-region pricing reflects MPOB 2024-25 Malaysian benchmarks + GAPKI Indonesian reports + PNG palm concession discount.
